categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in the aluminum rolling sector, producing wide aluminum rolled products used in various industries including foil materials, fins, secondary battery cathode foils, condenser cases, nameplates, caps, architectural materials, automotive materials, soundproof walls, printing plates, insulation materials, cosmetics caps, electronic components, and kitchenware. It operates a single business division focused on aluminum plate manufacturing and processing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes continuous casting, slab casting, and hot rolling production lines to manufacture aluminum plates. It emphasizes advanced alloy development, product performance improvement, and process optimization for cost efficiency and high productivity. The company holds patents related to aluminum alloys for automotive heat exchangers and high-strength, high-formability aluminum alloys for automotive bodies produced via twin-roll continuous casting.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic foil manufacturers such as Lotte Aluminum and Dongwon Systems, accounting for approximately 37% of sales, as well as various metal processing companies and wholesalers. The end markets span automotive, electronics, construction, packaging, secondary batteries, and consumer goods industries both domestically and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with headquarters and production facilities in Gyeongsangbuk-do, Gyeongsan City. It exports products to Southeast Asia, China, the United States, Japan, and Europe, with direct exports primarily to Europe and local exports to other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates midstream in the aluminum supply chain, focusing on aluminum rolling and processing from raw aluminum ingots and slabs to finished rolled aluminum products supplied to downstream manufacturers and end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening product competitiveness through advanced alloy development, performance enhancement, and production process improvements to achieve low-cost, high-efficiency manufacturing. R&D efforts focus on new alloy development for automotive and high-value-added applications, supported by an in-house technical research institute established in 2005.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of aluminum rolled products and aluminum plate processing services. Pricing is linked to global aluminum prices (LME) and premiums (MJP), with sales conducted via domestic wholesalers, direct customers, and export channels under order-based production.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the top domestic aluminum rolling companies, holding approximately 13.1% market share in 2023, competing with major players like Novelis Korea (82.6%) and Daehwa AL (4.3%). The industry has high entry barriers due to capital intensity and technological requirements, leading to an oligopolistic market structure.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately KRW 465.8 billion, a 17.2% decrease from the previous year, with operating profit of KRW 8.5 billion and a net loss of KRW 0.13 billion. Total assets stood at KRW 390.9 billion, with equity of KRW 191.4 billion. The company experienced a decline in production and sales volumes and a decrease in operating margin due to lower aluminum prices and market slowdown.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself by offering a diversified product portfolio ranging from general aluminum rolled products to high-value-added materials such as secondary battery cathode foils and high-alloy products. Its integrated production capabilities including continuous casting, slab casting, and hot rolling lines enable flexible, small-lot, multi-product manufacturing with short lead times, meeting diverse customer demands across multiple industries.
